title: Fonts per object
description: Every font use on the layouts: the base font of an object, a formatted part of a text, a chart text area — with font, size, face, source and style. Filters for file, theme, layout, font, size, source, face and object type, plus a search. By default the objects whose font is left to the default of the file stay out (the theme names none, so the export holds no font name for them); the source chips show them on request. A click opens the layout object; the arrow opens the layout with the object marked.
author: fm-lab

params.name: file
params.description: File filter: file names, comma-separated (the app-level file filter is one of them); empty = all files.

params.name: scope_uuids
params.description: Analysis-Test scope: comma-separated layout or layout-object UUIDs.

params.name: search
params.description: Search term, matched per font use (font, layout, object, field, theme, style, file, type, size, face, source, run/area).

params.name: theme
params.description: Theme filter: theme names separated by '|'; empty = all themes.

params.name: layout_uuid
params.description: Layout filter (UUID) — set by the layout select or by a row click in 'Fonts per layout'.

params.name: layout_file
params.description: File of the selected layout (tells cloned layouts apart); the layout select drops it.

params.name: font
params.description: Font filter: normalised font keys (lower case) separated by '|'; empty = all fonts.

params.name: size
params.description: Size filter: sizes such as 12pt separated by '|'; empty = all sizes.

params.name: face
params.description: Face chip: normal, bold, italic, bold italic; empty = all.

params.name: source
params.description: Source chip: empty = uses with a named font (all but the file default), 'all', or one of local, local_redundant, style, theme, rich_text, chart, default.

params.name: otype
params.description: Object-type chip: text, field, dropdown, popup, checkbox, radio, calendar, button, tab, chart; empty = all.

params.name: objects_sort
params.description: Sort column of the object list (server sort).
